turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know. Just feeling pretty down, I guess. It's all just felt like a lot of effort for no real reason.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's understandable to feel that way. Is there anything specific that's causing you to feel this way?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: There's nothing really... nothing that stands out, anyway. It's just everything feels, I don't know, flat, I suppose. Nothing really bothers me or excites me. Just a lot of nothing.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It's understandable to feel overwhelmed and exhausted. Is there anything that you would like to do to help yourself feel better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know... I used to like reading, but it's just not been something I can get into lately. I've tried watching TV, but that's not really working either. Nothing seems to... nothing seems interesting, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like a break from your daily routine might help. Do you think taking some time to do something different could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know... I don't really feel like doing anything, to be honest. It's not like I'm looking forward to anything. Just going through the motions, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like a change of scenery might help. Do you think going for a walk or a drive in a different environment could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't think so. Everywhere just feels the same, I guess. It's not like it would make a difference.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like a distraction from your current routine could help. Do you think trying something different like playing a game or watching a movie could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know... I've tried watching movies, but they just feel empty, like they're not even worth it. And games... I don't know, it's just not something I feel like doing, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like a conversation with a friend or family member could help. Do you think talking to someone you trust could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't really have anyone to talk to, actually. And even if I did, I don't know... it's not like they could really help, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like something to look forward to could help. Do you think setting a goal and working towards it could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know... what's the point of setting goals, anyway? Nothing really feels worthwhile, so why bother?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like a plan for the future could help. Do you think setting small achievable goals could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I don't know... what's the use? It's not like anything's going to get any better, anyway.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like taking some time for yourself could help. Do you think taking a break from your daily routine could help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I already take breaks... from everything, I guess. It's not like it makes a difference.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like taking a risk to do something different could help. Do you think trying something you haven't done before could help?
